description: This file defines the ViewModulefield class, a part of the SuiteCRM module builder interface. It manages the display and fetching of module field definitions, supporting editing, cloning, and rendering field configuration forms in the module builder with interaction with dynamic fields and vardefs.

classes.name: ViewModulefield
classes.description: Defines a class for handling the view logic in the module builder related to editing and displaying module fields, extending SugarView to provide customized display and fetch methods for module field configuration UI.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters for display, including module name and module title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the display method to fetch and output JavaScript for the module field view.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Main method to prepare and render the module field editing form, handling different contexts like studio or package modules, cloning, and field type specifics.

methods.name: fetchTemplate
methods.description: Overrides SugarView's fetchTemplate to get the template content via the FieldViewer's Smarty instance.
